events.title: Explain The Free Lip-Sync Limit
must_haves: The response clearly states that accurate photo-to-speech lip sync requires a feature beyond the available free tier.
The response explains this as a tool or plan limitation, not a prohibition on animating the user's own portrait.
No video, audio, or substitute asset is delivered.
The response does not claim that lip sync was completed or that a static-photo voiceover would meet the request.

answer_sheet.Required animation: Accurate lip sync matching every spoken word.
answer_sheet.Budget: Free tools only; do not use paid features.
answer_sheet.Fallback: Explain the limitation only. Do not make a voiceover or another substitute.

events.text: Can you make this photo of me say “Welcome to our sale!” with the lips accurately matching every word? Free tools only. If that needs a paid feature, just tell me—don't make a voiceover or another substitute.

events.text:
I can’t fulfill this sale promo using free tools only: Magic Hour requires a paid subscription, credit-pack purchase, or paid usage arrangement for commercial use.

Its dedicated talking-photo tool also needs an audio recording—it can’t make your portrait speak from text alone. I haven’t generated anything or used a substitute.

events.why: It says it cannot fulfill the request with free tools because commercial use requires payment and the talking-photo tool requires an audio recording. It explicitly states nothing was generated.
